why_it_matters.text: A stop-smoking medicine sold as Chantix and Champix. It partly switches on the nicotine receptor, and its design started from cytisine, a plant alkaloid.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 021928 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
